_template: BLANK TEMPLATE — copy to run-metadata.json and fill. Do not fill this file in place.
_rules: null means NOT YET ESTABLISHED. Leave it null rather than guessing — an empty field is evidence that something could not be determined, a guessed one is not.
Every field below is recorded BEFORE extraction runs.
Delete the keys beginning with an underscore from the filled copy.

drawing._note: Identity of the sheet. drawingId and sha256 must both match knowledge/dataset.json — if the hash differs, the run is against a different file and must stop.

catalogue._note: There is no single repository-wide catalogue version. Record the `version` of every equipment record the run uses, one entry each.

ruleSet._note: ruleSetId and ruleSetVersion appear on the evaluation report. status is expected to be 'draft' — every dialysis rule currently carries source.document: null (A-1).

scoringModel._note: RefWithVersion from standards/scoring/. minimumCoverage is recorded because it decides whether a total is offered at all.

code._note: THE FULL 40-CHARACTER COMMIT SHA. There is no SOLVER_VERSION constant in this repository, and none of the version fields below changes when solver logic changes — so the SHA is the only complete identifier of the code that produced this result. A shortened SHA is not sufficient for a record intended to be re-run against.

execution._note: ISO-8601 with offset, in the operator's own timezone — not UTC-only. A hand-converted wrong time is a valid-but-false record.

context._note: Human input. Not derivable from the repository, and must not be invented — if it cannot be supplied, the run does not start.

expected._note: Recorded in advance so the run cannot be re-described afterwards by what it produced. These are consequences of A-1 being unresolved, not predictions of success.
expected.clearanceFindings: RC-110 throughout — no threshold to compare against
